## Statement · **draft**
Let $G$ be a group. For $x, y \in G$, the element $[x, y] := x y x^{-1} y^{-1}$ is the **commutator** of $x$ and $y$. The subgroup generated by all commutators,

$[G, G] := \langle\, [x, y] : x, y \in G \,\rangle \le G$

is the **commutator subgroup** (also called the **derived subgroup**) of $G$.
